credits.title: Come Romeo e Giulietta
credits.overview: A romantic drama loosely based on the life of Federica Paganelli, one of the first girls in the world to live with spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) for over 20 years.

credits.title: Male Fadàu
credits.overview: Set in the region of Sardinia in Italy in 1942. When a village fool retrieves a radio from a crashed German warplane, a mysterious, eerie voice emerges from the radio and starts to haunt him.

credits.title: Disamistade
credits.overview: The son of a Sardinian shepherd, Sebastiano Catte is a gentle and studious young man. At his mother’s urging, who dreams of seeing him become a doctor or a lawyer, he left his village to attend boarding school. In 1950, he suddenly returns home following the murder of his father.
